name: jrng-ui-workspace
description: A modern Angular component library for admin panels, dashboards and business applications.

scripts.start: npm run build:lib && ng serve docs
scripts.build:lib: ng build jrng-ui && npm run docs:inventory && node scripts/generate-public-registry.mjs && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs
scripts.build:docs: npm run build:lib && npm run build:docs:app
scripts.build:docs:app: node scripts/generate-enterprise-audits.mjs && npm run docs:inventory && npm run generate:docs-registry && npm run docs:generate-api-examples && npm run generate:demos && npm run generate:sitemap && npm run verify:doc-examples && npm run docs:validate-api-examples && node scripts/run-angular-cli.mjs build docs
scripts.build:ssr: npm run build:lib && ng build ssr-smoke
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build:lib && npm run build:docs:app
scripts.typecheck: ng build jrng-ui --configuration development && node scripts/run-angular-cli.mjs build docs --configuration development
scripts.docs:validate: npm run docs:check-completeness && npm run docs:check-routes && npm run docs:check-examples && npm run docs:validate-api-examples && npm run docs:check-advanced && npm run docs:validate-content && npm run verify:doc-examples
scripts.docs:audit: npm run docs:inventory && npm run generate:docs-registry && npm run docs:generate-api-examples && npm run docs:check-completeness && npm run docs:check-routes && npm run docs:check-examples && npm run docs:validate-api-examples && npm run docs:reports
scripts.generate:enterprise-audits: npm run build:lib && node scripts/generate-component-inventory.mjs && node scripts/generate-enterprise-audits.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:lib && node scripts/run-angular-cli.mjs test --watch=false
scripts.test:lib: npm run build:lib && ng test jrng-ui --watch=false
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:lib && ng test jrng-ui --watch=false --coverage
scripts.test:docs: npm run build:lib && node scripts/run-angular-cli.mjs test docs --watch=false
scripts.quality:enterprise: npm run generate:enterprise-audits && npm run verify:enterprise-audits && npm run verify:api && npm run verify:registry && npm run verify:spec-coverage && npm run verify:package && npm run verify:consumer && npm run verify:ssr
